item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00080","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C21","C07","C15"],"selected_candidate_label":"C21","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C21 supplied a highly distinctive, nearly verbatim administrative mechanism for the child's section 5: mandatory consultation by the Civil Service Commission with the Special Assistant to the President for Personnel Management, coupled with the Special Assistant's power to exclude particular matters from that consultation requirement and later terminate an exclusion. The child adapts this machinery specifically to functions under the Government Employees Training Act and the delegations in the new order. C07 is also closely related in subject, personnel, and institutional structure, but lacks the child's most distinctive consultation-and-exclusion language. C15 shares Civil Service Commission delegation and regulatory machinery but not the same structure or wording.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"In performing functions vested in it by the Act or delegated to it by this order, the Commission shall consult with the Special Assistant to the President for Personnel Management.","parent_excerpt":"the United States Civil Service Commission or the Chairman thereof, as the case may be, shall, in performing the following, consult with the Special Assistant to the President for Personnel Management","explanation":"The child directly reuses C21's distinctive requirement that the Commission consult the named Special Assistant while performing covered functions."},{"child_excerpt":"The Special Assistant to the President for Personnel Management may, from time to time and partly or wholly, (1) exclude any specific matter or matters from the operation of the provisions of subsection (a) of this section, and (2) terminate any exclusion effected under this subsection (b).","parent_excerpt":"The Special Assistant to the President for Personnel Management may, from time to time and partly or wholly, (1) exclude any specific matter or matters from the operation of the provisions of subsection (a) of this section, and (2) terminate any exclusion effected under this subsection (b).","explanation":"This entire two-part operative provision is reproduced essentially verbatim from C21, providing concrete evidence of direct drafting-template use."}]}
